minimal_MST_fixture.B: output column n contains eight S8 values n+1, n=0..7; n-major address8*n+k
minimal_MST_fixture.padding: A word448 low64 stores eight S8, high64 zero; words449..451 zero; B fills452..455

readout_primary.payload: two S64 per response, eight total

minimal_MST_fixture.expected_primary: eight S64 results [-4,-8,-12,-16,-20,-24,-28,-32]; each column is sum(A)*(n+1)

readout_secondary.payload: four sign-extended S32 carriers of S16-clipped values per response
readout_secondary.scope: separate later P2 readout-format test, not required by initial smoke

completion_rules: take all S initialization and result-write responses
take loader done/error before judging load complete
check EXEC rsp_error/row mask, then read actual result
capture each op3 response and store to S456..459 with ACK before using stored output
read stored result and write T sequentially, wait SEALED before commit
read four T words under backpressure and compare sink reference; no E/G or forced quantization/packing
last read take precedes RELEASE; no in-flight response before final completion
minimal_MST_fixture.primary_pipeline: S input/weights -> loader -> M -> four op3 responses -> S456..459 write ACK -> read S -> T BEGIN4/FILL4/COMMIT/READ4/RELEASE
minimal_MST_fixture.initialization_order: coordinated reset; op6 CLEAR_ALL ACK; op4 SET_SCALE ACK; S initialization ACKs; loader done/error take; op10 EXEC and readout

requirements.subject: M result/row failures
